Who we are 

 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at  www.digicert.com 

 Job summary 

 We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our development team. You'll design, build, and ship scalable and secure web applications, working closely with fellow developers, product managers, and other teams to turn requirements into reliable, well-crafted solutions. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys owning features end to end and contributing to technical decisions. 

  

 What you will do 

 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain features using Java on the backend and React on the frontend 

 Work within our Agile team, taking part in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives 

 Collaborate with product managers to understand requirements, refine scope, and deliver solutions that meet user and business needs 

 Work with other engineering teams to design scalable, maintainable architectures and well-defined APIs 

 Build and consume RESTful services and integrate with internal and third-party systems 

 Containerize applications and deploy and operate them on AWS using cloud-native services 

 Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code, and participate in code reviews 

 Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and production support, including troubleshooting and resolving issues 

 Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, security, and developer productivity 

 Share knowledge with teammates and mentor junior engineers where appropriate 

 
  

 What you will have 

 
  A minimum of 3+ years of professional software development experience 

 Strong proficiency in Java backend development 

 Solid experience building user interfaces with React, along with modern JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS 

 Experience with modern front-end technologies and best practices (e.g., state management, component libraries, UI/UX design). 

 Hands-on experience with containerization using Docker, including building, running, and deploying containerized applications. 

 Proven experience working in Agile environments, with a solid understanding of iterative delivery 

 Hands-on experience with AWS services (for example EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, or CloudFormation/Terraform) will be a strong plus 

 Experience designing and consuming REST APIs 

 Working knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases 

 Familiarity with version control (Git), automated testing, and CI/CD practices 

 Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across disciplines 

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 

 
  

 Preferred 

 
 Experience with microservices and event-driven architectures 

 Experience with Kubernetes orchestration in production 

 Knowledge of application security best practices 

 AWS certification (such as Solutions Architect Associate or Developer Associate) 

 Exposure to observability tooling (CloudWatch, New Relic, Datadog, or similar) 

 Agile certification (such as Scrum Master or SAFe) 

 
  

 Nice to have 

 
 A problem-solving mindset and attention to quality 

 The ability to balance pragmatism with good engineering practice 

 Curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies 

 Ownership of your work from design through production 

 
  

 Benefits 

 
 Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package    

 Generous paid time off, including holidays and additional leave options    

 Family-friendly leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and other supportive leave programs    

 Health and wellness support, including medical  cover  (where applicable), gym reimbursements, and mental well-being resources    

 Pension, life insurance, and income protection benefits (location dependent)    

 Employee Assistance Program with 24/7 confidential support for employees and their families    

 Education assistance and professional development opportunities    

 Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources    

 Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts    

 Business travel insurance and global employee support programs   

 
 To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.
